component: Retention policy locks and initialization order

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: setDisabledStates applies either an explicit force value or the Folder Properties account-default checkbox. Folder initialization returns when that helper fully disables controls. Account-dialog initialization likewise returns immediately after a locked retainBy preference forces all controls disabled. Only the remaining path calls updateStates, which combines individual numeric locks with policy values 2 and 3. updateStates itself does not remember a prior global disable; preserve the caller guards and call order rather than treating it as an independent all-state reconciler. This is static source adoption, not a locked-preference UI test. Required discussion gaps keep full-audit credit at zero.
title: Retention callers guard full-disable state before selection-based numeric updates
